summary: In cmd_report (src/sensei_top/cli.py) I added '(no deck)' as the final COALESCE fallback for the four deck-label queries: the deck win-rate section (v_deck_winrate), play/draw (v_play_draw_winrate), game length (v_deck_game_length), and per-turn averages (v_deck_turn_curves). Each query now reads COALESCE(<name>, substr(<deck_id>, 1, 8), '(no deck)'), so an MTGO match with no picked deck gets a non-NULL label instead of crashing the print/format and slicing steps. No other logic or print formats were changed. Both check commands passed on the last run: pytest reported 2 passed in tests/test_cli_report.py, and ruff check reported all checks passed.
